## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Describe the situation, and why the current tools or behaviour do not cover it.

## Proposed solution

Describe the change you would like to see. If it involves a new MCP tool, describe its name, its inputs, and what it returns.

## Alternatives

Other approaches you considered, including workarounds you use today.

## Additional context

Anything else that helps: EF Core features involved, sample models, links to related issues or documentation.
